findings.title: Exclusive-Hackers breach US Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform
findings.summary_md: Reuters reported on November 27, 2026 that hackers had breached Cloud One, the Air Force's flagship cloud platform, citing three people familiar with the matter. The intrusion was discovered during upgrade work within the previous month and had paused application migrations, blocked updates and prompted some administrator-rights revocations. Reuters could not establish the attackers' identity, the vulnerability, the full scope or whether data was stolen.

findings.title: Cloud One: Taking aim at the enemy, one application at a time
findings.summary_md: Cloud One leadership said the platform hosted two named mission applications plus 97 others and had a 100% success rate against 10 million adversarial penetration attempts per year. The commentary said TICMS tracked munitions assets across 210 worldwide locations after moving to Cloud One in 2020.
